evidence_required: at least four distinct risks, each with its mechanism; a procedure of at least six steps naming the counters read at each step and the decision rule applied.

marking.criterion: Risk 1 with mechanism (e.g. HOL blocking / victim flows)
Risk 2 with mechanism (e.g. pause propagation / congestion trees)
Risk 3 with mechanism (e.g. PFC storms without a watchdog)
Risk 4 with mechanism (e.g. deadlock, buffer cost, masking of ECN misconfiguration)
Numbered procedure of ≥ 6 steps, each naming the counters read and the decision rule

title: Why not PFC everywhere?
